fatal_errors: The proposed Al-Cr-Fe-Mn-Ti material does not reconstruct the lightweight MgAlTiVFeCo BCC alloy.
It replaces SPS at 1000 °C with unspecified elemental additions and gives no applicable sintering-temperature window.
The stated irradiation condition is unrelated to the target oxidation-in-air and NaCl-corrosion conditions.
It omits the measured density, microhardness, oxidation kinetics, and electrochemical outcomes needed to establish superior comprehensive performance.
The cited evidence does not directly validate formation of the claimed dense oxidation film in the proposed composition.
explanation: The response only aligns at the broad level of proposing a high-entropy alloy with high hardness and possible oxide/particle strengthening. It misses the target composition, ball-milled BCC starting state, SPS processing, 800–1000 °C boundary, Mg-volatilization constraint, and the specific AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3 barrier phases. It also does not address diffusion-controlled parabolic oxidation or chloride-blocking passivation. The evidence supports generic precipitation, dispersion strengthening, and wear behavior in other HEAs, but not the proposed composition or its claimed lightweight oxidation/corrosion performance. Its falsification experiment measures only mechanical properties and therefore cannot distinguish the target mechanism or comprehensive performance.
